topic_intro: 공원에서 만난 친구, 그리고 달라진 마음
sentence: One day, Tim got a call from Jack. "Hello, Tim. How's everything going with Mickey?" Tim replied, "Actually, it's pretty hard walking him every day. We've been taking the same route, and it has become a little boring." Jack offered him a new idea. "How about going to Happy Dog Park?" When Tim and Mickey arrived at the park Jack had recommended, dozens of dogs were already jumping and playing. Just then, Tim saw a boy about his age standing with a small dog. Gathering his courage, Tim walked over to him. Having something in common as dog owners, Tim and Daniel enjoyed talking to each other. They spent the next two hours pleasantly chatting and decided to walk their dogs together regularly. After returning from a walk one day, Tim said to Mickey, "Walking you felt like a burden at first, but now I see doing things for you can be great for me, too!"
